# Governor and capital placement finder mapmodes. Scores are baked into location variables by
# the placement search (bcm_proximity_finder_effects.txt); the colors below read them.
# The three best locations carry bcm_gf_top / bcm_cf_top (1/2/3) for the rank fills; a local
# maximum (score >= 80% of best and above every owned neighbor) carries bcm_gf_localmax /
# bcm_cf_localmax for the stripe.

# Rank fills: best, second, third.
@bcm_pf_first_r = 0
@bcm_pf_first_g = 203
@bcm_pf_first_b = 190
@bcm_pf_second_r = 42
@bcm_pf_second_g = 140
@bcm_pf_second_b = 6
@bcm_pf_third_r = 55
@bcm_pf_third_g = 166
@bcm_pf_third_b = 41

# Scored gradient anchors, 100% of best (good) down to 0% (bad).
@bcm_pf_good_r = 80
@bcm_pf_good_g = 200
@bcm_pf_good_b = 80
@bcm_pf_moderate_r = 215
@bcm_pf_moderate_g = 205
@bcm_pf_moderate_b = 90
@bcm_pf_fair_r = 215
@bcm_pf_fair_g = 140
@bcm_pf_fair_b = 60
@bcm_pf_poor_r = 195
@bcm_pf_poor_g = 70
@bcm_pf_poor_b = 60
@bcm_pf_bad_r = 45
@bcm_pf_bad_g = 40
@bcm_pf_bad_b = 40

# Fallback fills and the secondary stripes.
@bcm_pf_notscored_r = 140
@bcm_pf_notscored_g = 140
@bcm_pf_notscored_b = 140
@bcm_pf_foreign_r = 110
@bcm_pf_foreign_g = 100
@bcm_pf_foreign_b = 90
@bcm_pf_unowned_r = 90
@bcm_pf_unowned_g = 90
@bcm_pf_unowned_b = 90
# Skipped by the Search Accuracy setting: never evaluated this run.
@bcm_pf_skipped_r = 0
@bcm_pf_skipped_g = 0
@bcm_pf_skipped_b = 0
@bcm_pf_stripe_r = 205
@bcm_pf_stripe_g = 206
@bcm_pf_stripe_b = 205
@bcm_pf_source_r = 255
@bcm_pf_source_g = 0
@bcm_pf_source_b = 255
@bcm_pf_gov_source_r = 0
@bcm_pf_gov_source_g = 100
@bcm_pf_gov_source_b = 255

# Shared gradient_parameters block. Mirrors vanilla's @data_* heatmap group (the
# "Map mode that works well with data and heatmaps" section):
# in_game/gfx/map/map_modes/map_modes.txt:90
@bcm_pf_grad_zoom_step = 2
@bcm_pf_grad_alpha_inside = 1

@bcm_pf_grad_color_mult = 0.9
@bcm_pf_grad_edge_width = 0

bcm_governor_finder = {
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_land = no }
			value = define:NMapColors|WATER_MAP_COLOR
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_top  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
				var:bcm_gf_top = 1  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
			}
			value = rgb { @bcm_pf_first_r @bcm_pf_first_g @bcm_pf_first_b }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_top  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
				var:bcm_gf_top = 2  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
			}
			value = rgb { @bcm_pf_second_r @bcm_pf_second_g @bcm_pf_second_b }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_top  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
				var:bcm_gf_top = 3  # check-script: never set — written through a macro, as bcm_$M$_top in bcm_pf_rank_top
			}
			value = rgb { @bcm_pf_third_r @bcm_pf_third_g @bcm_pf_third_b }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_score
				var:bcm_gf_score >= 750
			}
			lerp = {
				max_color = rgb { @bcm_pf_good_r @bcm_pf_good_g @bcm_pf_good_b }
				min_color = rgb { @bcm_pf_moderate_r @bcm_pf_moderate_g @bcm_pf_moderate_b }
				factor = {
					value = var:bcm_gf_score
					subtract = 750
					divide = 250
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_score
				var:bcm_gf_score >= 500
			}
			lerp = {
				max_color = rgb { @bcm_pf_moderate_r @bcm_pf_moderate_g @bcm_pf_moderate_b }
				min_color = rgb { @bcm_pf_fair_r @bcm_pf_fair_g @bcm_pf_fair_b }
				factor = {
					value = var:bcm_gf_score
					subtract = 500
					divide = 250
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_score
				var:bcm_gf_score >= 250
			}
			lerp = {
				max_color = rgb { @bcm_pf_fair_r @bcm_pf_fair_g @bcm_pf_fair_b }
				min_color = rgb { @bcm_pf_poor_r @bcm_pf_poor_g @bcm_pf_poor_b }
				factor = {
					value = var:bcm_gf_score
					subtract = 250
					divide = 250
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_score
			}
			lerp = {
				max_color = rgb { @bcm_pf_poor_r @bcm_pf_poor_g @bcm_pf_poor_b }
				min_color = rgb { @bcm_pf_bad_r @bcm_pf_bad_g @bcm_pf_bad_b }
				factor = {
					value = var:bcm_gf_score
					divide = 250
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_skip
			}
			value = rgb { @bcm_pf_skipped_r @bcm_pf_skipped_g @bcm_pf_skipped_b }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner ?= scope:actor }
			value = rgb { @bcm_pf_notscored_r @bcm_pf_notscored_g @bcm_pf_notscored_b }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = owner }
			value = rgb { @bcm_pf_foreign_r @bcm_pf_foreign_g @bcm_pf_foreign_b }
		}
		else = {
			value = rgb { @bcm_pf_unowned_r @bcm_pf_unowned_g @bcm_pf_unowned_b }
		}
	}

	secondary_map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_land = yes
				owner ?= scope:actor
				is_capital = yes
			}
			value = rgb { @bcm_pf_source_r @bcm_pf_source_g @bcm_pf_source_b }

		else_if = {

				is_land = yes

			value = rgb { @bcm_pf_gov_source_r @bcm_pf_gov_source_g @bcm_pf_gov_source_b }

		}

		else_if = {

				var:bcm_gf_score = 0
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_ZERO
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_score
				var:bcm_gf_score >= 1000
				debug_only = yes
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_BEST_DEBUG
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {

				has_variable = bcm_gf_score
				debug_only = yes

			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_SCORED_DEBUG

				modifier:local_proximity_source > 0
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_SOURCE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_nogain
				modifier:local_proximity_source > 0
				debug_only = yes
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_SOURCE_NOGAIN_DEBUG
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_nogain
				modifier:local_proximity_source > 0
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_SOURCE_NOGAIN
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_nogain
				debug_only = yes
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_NOGAIN_DEBUG
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_nogain
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_NOGAIN
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_score
				var:bcm_gf_score = 0
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_ZERO
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_score
				var:bcm_gf_score >= 1000
				debug_only = yes
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_BEST_DEBUG
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_score
				debug_only = yes
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_SCORED_DEBUG
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_score
				var:bcm_gf_score >= 1000
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_BEST
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_score
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_SCORED
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_inelig
				debug_only = yes
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_INELIGIBLE_DEBUG
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_inelig
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_INELIGIBLE
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_skip
				debug_only = yes
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_SKIPPED_DEBUG
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				has_variable = bcm_gf_skip
			}
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_SKIPPED
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner ?= scope:actor }
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_NO_DATA
		}
		else = {
			value = MAPMODE_BCM_GOVERNOR_FINDER_TT_FOREIGN
		}
	}

	legend_key = { desc = "bcm_pf_first_legend_key"       color = rgb { @bcm_pf_first_r @bcm_pf_first_g @bcm_pf_first_b } }
	legend_key = { desc = "bcm_pf_second_legend_key"      color = rgb { @bcm_pf_second_r @bcm_pf_second_g @bcm_pf_second_b } }
	legend_key = { desc = "bcm_pf_third_legend_key"       color = rgb { @bcm_pf_third_r @bcm_pf_third_g @bcm_pf_third_b } }
	legend_key = { desc = "bcm_pf_good_legend_key"        color = rgb { @bcm_pf_good_r @bcm_pf_good_g @bcm_pf_good_b } }
	legend_key = { desc = "bcm_pf_moderate_legend_key"    color = rgb { @bcm_pf_moderate_r @bcm_pf_moderate_g @bcm_pf_moderate_b } }
	legend_key = { desc = "bcm_pf_fair_legend_key"        color = rgb { @bcm_pf_fair_r @bcm_pf_fair_g @bcm_pf_fair_b } }
	legend_key = { desc = "bcm_pf_poor_legend_key"        color = rgb { @bcm_pf_poor_r @bcm_pf_poor_g @bcm_pf_poor_b } }
	legend_key = { desc = "bcm_pf_bad_legend_key"         color = rgb { @bcm_pf_bad_r @bcm_pf_bad_g @bcm_pf_bad_b } }
	legend_key = { desc = "bcm_pf_localmax_legend_key"    color = rgb { @bcm_pf_stripe_r @bcm_pf_stripe_g @bcm_pf_stripe_b } }
	legend_key = { desc = "bcm_pf_gov_capital_legend_key" color = rgb { @bcm_pf_source_r @bcm_pf_source_g @bcm_pf_source_b } }
	legend_key = { desc = "bcm_pf_gov_source_legend_key"  color = rgb { @bcm_pf_gov_source_r @bcm_pf_gov_source_g @bcm_pf_gov_source_b } }

	legend_key = { desc = "bcm_pf_skipped_legend_key"     color = rgb { @bcm_pf_skipped_r @bcm_pf_skipped_g @bcm_pf_skipped_b } }
